description: Pins protocol-adjacent frontmatter field patchers in src/dialect/surgery.ts — pure Uint8Array → Uint8Array transforms that insert/replace/remove a single frontmatter field while leaving the rest of the note (and YAML formatting) byte-stable. Eight case_kinds, one per patcher: updated (patchUpdatedField, ISO arg), title (patchTitleField), folder/trashed/archived/template (nullable patchers — value null removes the field; an absent input_value_utf8_hex encodes null), folder-index (patchFolderIndexField, boolean flag), generic (patchFrontmatterField, key+nullable value). Each output is a fixed point (idempotent) and the patch is pure (input untouched). TS-runner category (no Rust generator); the live patchers are asserted by tests/dialect/frontmatterSurgery.test.ts.
